name: Expanding a bill line reveals the rule that produced it

planSteps.description: Open the app, wait for the initial solve, then scroll to the two bills side by side.
Click the row labelled 'Overnight' in the SCHEDULED bill.
Verify the row expands to show the minutes billed, the micro-USD-per-kWh rate, and the energy, rather than only the amount.
Verify the row collapses back to its single line.
